data.narrative:
Newcleo is a Series B nuclear energy company that has raised $755M+ to date. The nuclear energy sector contains three public comparables (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and eight private peers including Oklo, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, Fuse Energy, and Aalo Atomics, though the narrow peer set at equivalent stage and valuation tier remains limited.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable method given data constraints. Using $755M in total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $1.4B. A conservative sensitivity range of ±15% produces a low bound of $1.2B and a high bound of $1.6B. Peer-median comparison proved inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage and same-tier comparables in the nuclear energy sector—only one adjacent-stage peer and zero same-stage peers met filter criteria, falling short of the minimum three-point threshold for reliable cross-sectional analysis.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.2B to $1.6B, centered on $1.4B. Key uncertainties include the early-stage maturity of nuclear energy private markets (limiting peer comparability), the company's specific capital deployment trajectory relative to sector averages, and technology-to-commercialization risk inherent in frontier nuclear development. Additional disclosure of recent fund-raise terms or revenue metrics would substantially improve precision.
